title: Harrington's global-economy reason for secrecy

tellings.quote: That's the global economy. If you disrupt that by taking away the reason for people to live their lives, everything falls apart and governments of the world will not be able to control the populace.

plain: A former US Secretary of Energy named John S. Herrington gave a reason for keeping UFOs secret: disclosure would upset the global economy by "taking away the reason for people to live their lives," so that "everything falls apart" and governments could no longer control their people. A man named Brent Friedman says Herrington told him this, and repeats it to Michels. If true, it would mean secrecy was kept to protect social and economic order rather than military advantage.
